06 Security & ownership

Your data. Your database.
Your brand.

Enterprise-grade protection by default — and a self-hosted option for teams that want to hold the keys to their own client data.

Bank-grade encryption

AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit. Backups are encrypted on disk, always.

AES-256 · TLS 1.3

Access you control

Role-based permissions and strict tenant isolation — directors, managers and agents see only what they should.

RBAC · Tenant isolation

Privacy by default

Sensitive fields are opt-in, and our support team has zero access to custom sensitive fields.

Data minimisation

Always on

Weekly automated backups with 24/7 monitoring and uptime checks.

Weekly backups · 24/7

Bring your own database

Run it on your infrastructure, under your domain.

Point RealSalePro at your own PostgreSQL on AWS or a Hostinger VPS. Whitelist our static IP, hand over a scoped connection string, and we validate the handshake before anything goes live.

  • AWS RDS or EC2 · Hostinger VPS
  • PostgreSQL v12+ or MySQL v8.0+
  • White-label hosting on crm.yourcompany.com
  • Custom incentive automation on your own schema
Talk to the setup team

Self-hosted deployments carry a one-time database setup & deployment fee for provisioning, firewall hardening and SSL configuration.

Good answers.

Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our team — a human replies.

Yes! RealSalePro is 100% free forever for small teams. The Free plan supports up to 1,000 leads and up to 5 users, and includes the pro features such as automated lead routing, pipeline visualisation and inventory tracking — without any credit card details.

Absolutely. RealSalePro supports custom fields, workflows, branding (logo and colours), role-based permissions and custom reports. A Business Customisation package (starting at ₹19,999) tailors the platform to your specific business, and API access is available for advanced integrations.

Security is the priority. We use AES-256 encryption for data at rest, TLS 1.3 for data in transit, role-based access control and strict tenant isolation. Backups run weekly, monitoring is 24/7, and self-hosted deployment is available for enterprises that need maximum control.

Yes. Every subscription includes onboarding support: live video training for your team, a dedicated onboarding manager for the first 30 days, data migration assistance from Excel or another CRM, 24/7 email and chat support, and priority phone support on enterprise plans.

UPI, credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), net banking, and bank transfers (NEFT/RTGS/IMPS). Enterprise clients can use invoice-based billing with NET-30 terms. All transactions are secured with PCI-DSS compliant encryption.

Yes — WhatsApp Business API, Google Workspace, Zapier, payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU), accounting software and the portals and ad platforms you already use. REST APIs are available for custom integrations, with dedicated integration support on enterprise plans.
